title: Towards Characterizing a Neural Network's Native Ontology: Coherent Sets of Data Through Layers and Over Training
subtitle: or, Sparse Eigenbases of the Tempered Cross-Hankel Operator for Spectral Identification of the Kantian Categories by Neural Coherent Sets
description: A label-free procedure, and a language, for finding which images a neural network treats alike, layer by layer and over training: coherent sets in a ResNet-20 on CIFAR-10, with an interactive explorer.
